description: This Java source file defines the 'ConfigWithFallback' class which implements the 'ScopedConfig' and 'ConfigMergeable' interfaces. The class provides functionality for creating configuration objects with fallback values based on a specific config path in the Typesafe Config library. It includes static factory methods to instantiate the class with fallback values, as well as numerous accessor methods to retrieve configuration data at various paths, types, and formats.
